I need fewer advice from you.

questions.questionText: What must the listeners do before the tour begins?

feedback.reasoning: She explicitly instructs the attendees to pick up their badges before the tour: 'Before we begin our facility tour... please ensure you have picked up your employee ID badges.'
When discussing the ID badges, she mentions they are needed to access 'the cafeteria on the second floor.'

options: An IT setup session will start
A welcome luncheon will take place
A staff meeting will be held

questions.questionText: How can attendees identify the HR staff members?
